description: This file implements D-Bus client functionality for process container management, including handling state changes, asynchronous operations, connection management, and interface binding within a specific namespace. It defines callback structures, client methods for starting/stopping containers, connection handling, and thread management.

classes.name: DBusCallbacks
classes.description: Contains static callback functions for handling D-Bus signals and asynchronous responses.

classes.name: Client::Interface
classes.description: Represents a container interface with methods to handle state changes, start, and stop containers.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Main D-Bus client class managing connection, interface binding, threading, and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: handleStateChange
methods.description: Static callback to handle container state change signals.

methods.name: asyncReady
methods.description: Static callback invoked when an asynchronous D-Bus call completes.

methods.name: Client::Interface::Interface
methods.description: Constructor initializing interface with a name.

methods.name: Client::Interface::stateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for the interface.

methods.name: Client::Interface::startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container with specified command and parameters, with a timeout.

methods.name: Client::Interface::stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a container with a specified timeout.

methods.name: Client::connectionResetIfNeeded
methods.description: Ensures the connection is active, establishing it if necessary.

methods.name: Client::connect
methods.description: Connects to the D-Bus service and sets up signal handlers.

methods.name: Client::waitForResult
methods.description: Waits for an asynchronous operation to complete or timeout.

methods.name: Client::connectBus
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the D-Bus system bus.

methods.name: Client::disconnectBus
methods.description: Disconnects from the D-Bus system bus.

methods.name: Client::exec
methods.description: Runs the main event loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: Client::findInterface
methods.description: Finds a bound interface by ID.

methods.name: Client::bind
methods.description: Binds an interface to the client.

methods.name: Client::unbind
methods.description: Unbinds an interface from the client.
